supporting_evidence.summary: significant deviations in scope [all services]: emailservice_latency-90 z=902.24 (4511.2%); emailservice_latency-50 z=331.77 (1658.9%); checkoutservice_latency-90 z=20.94 (104.7%); checkoutservice_latency-50 z=11.04 (193.5%)
traces for emailservice: SIGNIFICANT change; own spans self-time p50 0.19->0.19ms (1.01x), errors 0.0->0.0; inbound calls self-time p50 3.66->203.82ms (55.67x), errors 0.0->0.0

alternatives_rejected.why: Its latency deviation is modest (p90 z=20.94, +104.7%) next to emailservice (p90 z=902.24, +4511%) (E1). Inbound calls to emailservice slowed 3.66->203.82ms (E2), so checkout's slowdown is most likely inherited while it waits on email calls.

Its own span self-time is unchanged (0.19->0.19ms, E2), so processing is not slower. No cpu or mem metric deviations appear in the all-service ranking (E1). Only latency seen by callers grew, which fits network delay.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect and remove the network delay affecting emailservice (e.g., tc/netem rules or a sidecar/network policy on its pod), or reschedule the emailservice pod onto a healthy node. Then confirm that the latency seen by callers and checkoutservice latency return to baseline.
